title: Malaysia cumulative mean revenue loss
limitations: Historical input provenance is incomplete; inspection only; the assessment is not recomputable.
The model does not establish causal identification; figures are conditional estimates, not causal attribution.
Risk is defined as neutral revenue minus event revenue; the mean is signed, so gains are retained, while tail measures use positive shortfall.
Units are constant 2025 USD, GDP-deflated, at a fixed 2025 exchange rate; price and exchange-rate responses are not modeled.
The estimate covers agriculture, forestry and fishing value added and conditional government revenue transmission, not total-economy loss and not sovereign default probability.
